components.css: :root{--void:#090808;--bone:#ece0c6;--ash:#968472;--amber:#ffd280;--flame:#ff9c40;--rule:rgb(150 132 114 / 0.2);--fell:"IM Fell English","Iowan Old Style",Palatino,Georgia,serif;--fell-sc:"IM Fell English SC",var(--fell);--mono:"JetBrains Mono",Menlo,Consolas,monospace;}.ds-text-action{padding:0;border:0;background:none;font-family:var(--fell);font-size:16px;font-style:italic;color:var(--bone);text-decoration:underline;text-decoration-color:rgb(255 210 128 / 0.45);text-decoration-thickness:1px;text-underline-offset:0.22em;cursor:pointer;transition:color 160ms ease-out,text-decoration-color 160ms ease-out;}.ds-text-action:hover{color:var(--amber);text-decoration-color:var(--amber);}.ds-text-action:focus-visible{outline:1px solid var(--amber);outline-offset:4px;}

components.css: :root{--void:#090808;--bone:#ece0c6;--ash:#968472;--amber:#ffd280;--flame:#ff9c40;--rule:rgb(150 132 114 / 0.2);--fell:"IM Fell English","Iowan Old Style",Palatino,Georgia,serif;--fell-sc:"IM Fell English SC",var(--fell);--mono:"JetBrains Mono",Menlo,Consolas,monospace;}.ds-popover{width:min(640px,100%);padding:28px 32px 24px;background:var(--void);color:var(--bone);box-shadow:0 24px 80px rgb(0 0 0 / 0.7);font-family:var(--fell);}.ds-popover h2{margin:0 0 16px;font-family:var(--fell-sc);font-weight:400;font-size:22px;letter-spacing:0.14em;color:var(--amber);}.ds-popover table{width:100%;border-collapse:collapse;font-size:16px;}.ds-popover th{width:34%;padding:5px 16px 5px 0;text-align:left;font-weight:400;white-space:nowrap;vertical-align:baseline;}.ds-popover td{padding:5px 0;vertical-align:baseline;}.ds-popover tr+tr>*{border-top:1px solid rgb(150 132 114 / 0.1);}.ds-popover kbd{font-family:var(--mono);font-size:0.92em;color:var(--amber);}.ds-or{font-style:italic;color:var(--ash);font-size:0.9em;}.ds-close{display:block;margin:18px 0 0 auto;padding:0;border:0;background:none;font:inherit;font-style:italic;color:var(--ash);cursor:pointer;}.ds-close:hover{color:var(--amber);}.ds-close:focus-visible{outline:1px solid var(--amber);outline-offset:4px;}

components.css: :root{--void:#090808;--bone:#ece0c6;--ash:#968472;--amber:#ffd280;--flame:#ff9c40;--rule:rgb(150 132 114 / 0.2);--fell:"IM Fell English","Iowan Old Style",Palatino,Georgia,serif;--fell-sc:"IM Fell English SC",var(--fell);--mono:"JetBrains Mono",Menlo,Consolas,monospace;}.ds-masthead{display:flex;align-items:baseline;justify-content:space-between;gap:2rem;padding:20px 4px;background:var(--void);}.ds-masthead h1{margin:0 -0.32em 0 0;font-family:var(--fell-sc);font-weight:400;font-size:30px;line-height:1;letter-spacing:0.32em;color:var(--amber);white-space:nowrap;}.ds-masthead p{margin:0;max-width:76ch;text-align:right;font-family:var(--fell);font-size:16px;line-height:1.35;color:var(--ash);}.ds-masthead em{display:block;color:var(--bone);}

components.name: Veil
components.description: The dimming over the game screen with the unlit candle and one call; hover lights the flame here as a preview.
components.css: :root{--void:#090808;--bone:#ece0c6;--ash:#968472;--amber:#ffd280;--flame:#ff9c40;--rule:rgb(150 132 114 / 0.2);--fell:"IM Fell English","Iowan Old Style",Palatino,Georgia,serif;--fell-sc:"IM Fell English SC",var(--fell);--mono:"JetBrains Mono",Menlo,Consolas,monospace;}.ds-veil{display:grid;justify-items:center;gap:14px;width:100%;padding:48px 24px;border:0;background:radial-gradient(ellipse 30em 12em at 50% 50%,rgb(9 8 8 / 0.96) 35%,transparent 100%),rgb(9 8 8 / 0.9);color:var(--bone);font-family:var(--fell);cursor:pointer;}.ds-veil:focus-visible{outline:1px solid var(--amber);outline-offset:-6px;}.ds-candle{width:30px;height:60px;overflow:visible;}.ds-flame{transform-origin:12px 19px;transform:scale(0);opacity:0;transition:transform 260ms cubic-bezier(0.16,1,0.3,1),opacity 120ms ease-out;}.ds-ember{transition:opacity 200ms ease-out;}.ds-veil:hover .ds-flame{transform:scale(1);opacity:1;}.ds-veil:hover .ds-ember{opacity:0;}.ds-call{font-style:italic;font-size:26px;line-height:1.15;text-align:center;}.ds-note{max-width:44ch;font-size:16px;color:var(--ash);text-align:center;}

narrative.overview:
The page is the game's own dark. The 100×30 game screen is a canvas drawn by the game and is not part of this system; the page is built to sit flush on that canvas's void, so the screen has no frame, no bezel and no card around it. Everything the page adds is a few lines of words set above and below the screen like the rubrics of a printed order of service: what to do in amber, what it means in bone, the small print in ash.

The world is sober, warm and nearly empty. One seventeenth-century face (IM Fell English, Bishop Fell's types, church and college in one) carries every word; the game's monospace appears only where a literal key is named. Density is low on purpose: the screen takes most of the height, and the words above and below are aligned to its measured edges. Light is the only spectacle. A dimming veil covers the screen until the first click or key, a small drawn candle stands at its centre, and lighting it opens the dark outward from the flame.

The product rejects the category default for a game embed: no hero, no feature cards, no big Play button, no CRT costume (scanlines, glow, curvature), no emoji.
keyCharacteristics: Void ground continuous with the game screen; no frame around the canvas.
One serif voice (IM Fell English, roman, italic and small caps) for all words; monospace for literal keys only.
Amber marks what to do; bone carries meaning; ash carries the small print.
Hairline rules in ash, never boxes or bordered panels.
Motion is light itself: a flame that flickers and a dark that opens.

rules.name: The Rubric Rule
rules.body: Amber means "this is what you do". It goes on keys, the name, focus and hover, and never on body prose or decoration.

rules.name: The One Flame Rule
rules.body: Flame orange appears only on the candle. If something else on the page is that colour, it is wrong.

rules.name: The Flush Void Rule
rules.body: The page ground is exactly the game's void (`void`). No off-black, no gradient, no texture behind the screen.

rules.name: The Literal Key Rule
rules.body: Monospace appears only for a key the player presses. Words like "direction", "or" and "and" between keys stay in Fell (joiners in ash italic at 0.9em).

rules.name: The Italic Is The Voice Rule
rules.body: Italic carries the voice that speaks to the player: the veil's call, the tagline's first line, and text actions. It is not used for emphasis inside prose.

rules.name: The Dark Is The Depth Rule
rules.body: Hierarchy over the screen is made by dimming and revealing the void, not by panels and shadows. A second shadow on the page needs a reason as strong as a modal.

rules.name: The Hairline Not Box Rule
rules.body: Separate with a 1px ash hairline (20% or less), never with a bordered or filled box. The popover is the one panel, and it is void on void.

dos: Do set the page ground to exactly `void` and let the game screen sit on it with no frame.
Do align the words above and below the screen to the screen's measured width.
Do set every literal key in JetBrains Mono amber, and everything else in IM Fell English.
Do make actions text: bone with a 45% amber underline, amber on hover over 160ms.
Do separate with a 1px ash hairline at 20% or less.
Do honour reduced motion: no flicker, no expanding light, a 200ms fade instead.
Do self-host every font and keep its OFL licence beside it.
donts: Don't box the game screen, or put the page inside cards, panels or bordered sections.
Don't add a hero, feature cards or a filled Play button; the veil's call is the only invitation.
Don't use flame orange anywhere but the candle and the favicon.
Don't use amber on body prose or decoration; it means "press this".
Don't add scanlines, glow, screen curvature or other CRT effects.
Don't use emoji or icon glyphs; the candle is the only drawn image.
